description: This file defines a Supervisor Data Transfer Object (DTO) class used within the OrangeHRM system for handling supervisor-related data in reports. It includes methods for serializing supervisor data to an array, retrieving supervisor information, and mapping fields to accessor methods.

classes.name: Supervisor
classes.description: A DTO class representing supervisor information for reports, capable of serializing supervisor data and retrieving supervisor details via Employee and ReportingMethod entities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the supervisor DTO with an employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the supervisor data to an array, fetching supervisor entities and normalizing their data.

methods.name: callGetterOnItem
methods.description: Retrieves specific fields from the employee entity, especially handling the 'supReportingMethod' field to return the reporting method's name.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Returns a mapping of field names to their respective getter methods in the Employee entity.
